note: PM GatiShakti Cargo Terminals (GCT) — dedicated dataset under Section F of the Techadyant master prompt. Each terminal is a stable entity. Where a terminal's per-terminal capacity is not separately published, the field is null and only the aggregate network figure (224 MTPA as of Jul 2026, PIB PRID 2288380) is used at the summary layer. Commissioning and operational statuses are kept distinct; sanctioned, proposed, and under-construction terminals are not conflated with commissioned ones. Operator identities are recorded when explicitly published; unresolved identities are flagged as constraints, not fabricated.
